# Gabriel Amram

I am a builder — of products, platforms and engineering organizations — at the intersection of engineering depth, product thinking and business outcomes.

Technology and engineering leader with more than 20 years of experience as a founder, CTO and engineering group lead, across startups and a large public technology company.

Currently Engineering Group Lead at monday.com, leading foundational engineering across service architecture, application-level infrastructure and authorization. Initiated mondayCore, an AI-ready service platform designed to let engineers and coding agents focus on business logic while the platform handles all non-functional requirements.
